description: This file defines a utility function 'resolveDaemonContainerContext' that retrieves and trims specific environment variables to determine the container context for a daemon.

methods.name: export function resolveDaemonContainerContext( resolveDaemonContainerContext
methods.description: Retrieves the container context by checking environment variables 'OPENCLAW_CONTAINER_HINT' and 'OPENCLAW_CONTAINER', trimming their values if present, and returning the first non-empty value or null.
